description: Set the DISPLAY order of one category's to-do items. orderedItemIds must list EXACTLY the category's non-archived items in the desired order. Strictly presentation: no version publish, no assignment change, no notification — and list position NEVER implies a prerequisite (use activation rules for sequencing). Naturally idempotent. Requires project_todos:write.

orderedItemIds.description: The category's complete non-archived item id set, in display order.

name: opentrain_reorder_project_todo_items
